data.body: [P2] Adding an eighth component changes this public record’s contract: existing seven-component record patterns stop compiling, while reflection, record serialization, equality, and hashing observe a different shape. Retaining the old constructors does not preserve those callers. Keep `InvocationInfo` at seven components and pass the snapshot through separate immutable metadata, such as a new default plugin-hook overload that delegates to the existing `onInvocationStart(InvocationInfo)`.
